result.title: A Label Noise Robust Algorithm for Graph Data using Neighborhood Label Distribution
result.summary: Graph Convolutional Networks (GCNs) have demonstrated exceptional performance on graph-structured data. However, their success heavily relies on the availability of clean labels, an assumption that often fails in real-world scenarios. The learnability of GCNs is intrinsically linked to the neighborhood structure of nodes, making it critical to understand how this structure changes in the presence of label noise. In this work, we investigate how the neighborhood label distribution of a node changes under label noise. We mathematically derive that label noise smooths this distribution, which inherently increases its entropy and severely decreases interclass distinguishability. To address this challenge, we propose Leave-one-out Entropy Node Screening (LENS), an end-to-end framework that identifies noisy nodes by measuring the reduction in neighborhood entropy when a specific node is removed. LENS further incorporates a relabeling mechanism to recover and preserve valuable feature information instead of entirely discarding the identified noisy nodes. Crucially, the end-to-end computational overhead of LENS is remarkably low. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that our algorithm achieves state-of-the-art node classification accuracy while executing an order of magnitude faster than existing noise-robust approaches.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文研究图数据节点分类中的标签噪声问题：推导出标签噪声会平滑节点的邻域标签分布、提高熵并降低类间可分性，进而提出 LENS 框架，通过移除某节点时邻域熵的下降来筛选噪声节点并配合重标注，在提速的同时达到领先精度。
AI.relevance_reason: 研究对象是 GCN 的图节点分类与标签噪声清洗，不涉及视觉或多模态推理、latent 状态生成与使用，其「留一熵筛选」思路与 LVR 的视觉证据筛选、贡献分配联系过于间接，暂无可供核查的具体借鉴线索。
